T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Good Day Sir,

I got your contact on  https://www.seamless.ai while conducting a research on Companies/Potential Individuals capable of taking this huge opportunity.

I am writing to introduce our company (FEDSURE INVESTMENTS (UK) as
we wish to establish a relationship with you and your organization.
FEDSURE INVESTMENTS (UK) is a Global trade finance company that

specializes in structuring complex trade transactions for any
company or individual involved in international trades (this
includes importers, exporters, trading companies and international
service providers.)

We are an Investment Consultant Company, and privately looking for Fiduciary agents and management experts who will be willing to act as an investment portfolio holders and administrators for our Angel Investors.

Our client area of project Financing/Investment centralizes on Sector-Focused services which includes:
1.Trading and sales
2.Resources and Oil Energy Group
3.Corporate Sector Group
4.Securities services.e.t.c
We can help provide Loans; Medium Term Notes (M.T.N) ,Bank
Instruments such as Bank Guarantees (BG), Standby Letter of Credit
to enable finance your business projects.


We are innovative and value driven in the business of Financing
several Business Projects as our Investors are large corporations, middle-market companies, Family-owned businesses, Well-known private equity firms, HNWI Investors.

The reason why we have contacted you is because we have made assessment and appraisal of your Company and it is clear to us that you might need an intervention in terms of Loan/Investment in your company as our Investor's wish-list is to re-invest their funds into the management of private businesses and corporations with good business ideas that can generate at least 10% ROI  per annum over maximum of 5 years duration.

We have a cash portfolio of over a billion dollars waiting for re-investment into any secure and reliable good ROI venture, projects, loans and seed ventures.

 If you are willing to receive this funds for re-investment under a Non Disclosure Joint Venture agreement for a renewable period of 5-10 years with an estimated (ROI) Return On Investments of between 7-10% each financial year.Please do not hesitate in reaching out to
us as we can arrange  a meeting with the Funds owners in Moldova, Qatar or United Kingdom immediately for further discussions.
